name: Rot Hide Origins
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...

One moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...
narrative.requestItemsText: My studies require great concentration. So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 14 to 24, 6,525 XP in all.

quests.name: The Dead Fields
quests.objectiveText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: The Decrepit Ferry
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

quests.name: Rot Hide Clues
quests.objectiveText: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Rot Hide Ichor
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Rot Hide Origins
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: Thule Ravenclaw
quests.objectiveText: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.

quests.name: Report to Hadrec
quests.objectiveText: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
quests.objectiveText: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
